text: pātheyyasuttaṃ [215] kiṃsu bandhati pātheyyaṃ kiṃsu bhogānamāsayo kiṃsu naraṃ parikassati kiṃsu lokasmi dujjahaṃ kismiṃ baddhā puthū sattā pāsena sakuṇī yathāti . #1 sī. satthamalantipi satthāmalantipi pāṭho . 2 sī. harentaṃ ... harento . #3 sī. vayo . [216] saddhā bandhati pātheyyaṃ siri bhogānamāsayo icchā naraṃ parikassati icchā lokasmi dujjahā icchābaddhā puthū sattā pāsena sakuṇī yathāti . dasamaṃ
